read.thesis: Q3 revenue $18.7B (+5% cc) and RoTE 18.8% YTD, but the read is cautious on deposit mix: Hong Kong time-deposit migration (38% vs 40% peak) is compressing margins while costs held near 1% growth.

triggers.label: HK time-deposit margin pressure
triggers.quote: In Hong Kong, we saw increased time deposit margin pressure this quarter.

triggers.label: Banking NII at least $46B held
triggers.quote: We reiterate our full year banking NII guidance of at least $46 billion.

triggers.label: Simplification savings $1.9B of $2B
triggers.quote: taking us to $1.9 billion of the $2 billion we set out at the half year

triggers.label: Basel 3.1 benefit 40-50bp CET1
triggers.quote: this benefit should be 40 to 50 basis points

guidance.quote: We reiterate our full year banking NII guidance of at least $46 billion.
We maintain our full year 2026 credit guidance of around 45 basis points.
We are on track to achieve our target of around 1% cost growth in 2026 compared to 2025 on a target basis.
Based on our latest modeling, this benefit should be 40 to 50 basis points.
